scheme_id.description: Unique identifier for the actantial scheme

function_in_plot.description: The function or role of this scheme in the overall narrative structure (e.g., 'Central quest/transformation of state', 'Competence acquisition', 'Secondary action')

interconnection_details.description: Optional: Details about how this actantial scheme relates to other schemes in the narrative

subject.description: The entity performing the main quest/action (Subject)

destinator.description: The instance that mandates or initiates the quest (Sender)

destination.description: The beneficiary of the Object of Value (Receiver)

helper.description: Forces/entities that facilitate the Subject's action (Helper)

opponent.description: Forces/entities that obstruct the Subject's action (Opponent)
